messages:
liam: FYI during a demo the curl snippet in /guides/runtime/quick-verify 403s. It references `https://short.redwood/demo/banner.png`. Anyone own that doc?

eva: thanks for flagging. Shortlinks are brittle after bucket IAM rotations. Which block is it in?

liam: the first example under 'Verify your deploy' 1.

eva: simple fix: swap the shortlink to `/assets/docs/runtime/banner.png` and add a parenthetical: (CDN-backed; durable). I'll open a tiny PR.

liam: sounds good. Could we also add a follow-up issue to lint for `short.redwood` in fenced code blocks? We've seen this crop up in onboarding.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4999 title: "docs: replace ephemeral shortlink in quick-verify example" assignee: eva.

ops: quick note 1: before merging, preview in staging to confirm the codeblock copy preserves backticks and doesn't escape characters. Staging preview link helps.

eva: will do. PR description includes staging preview steps and a sed one-liner to sweep other occurrences.

docs-bot: PR merged by ops 1: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4999 deployed to staging.

liam: verified staging preview; image loads and curl returns 200. created issue #1350 to add a lint rule for short.redwood in codeblocks. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
